dataset_description: World Health Organization / UN life expectancy and health indicators, covering roughly 193 countries from 2000 to 2015.

predictors.label: Adult Mortality (per 1,000 adults)
predictors.description: Probability of dying between ages 15-60, per 1,000 population. Higher = worse.

predictors.label: HIV/AIDS deaths (per 1,000, ages 0-4)
predictors.description: Deaths per 1,000 live births caused by HIV/AIDS, ages 0-4.

predictors.label: Under-Five Deaths (per 1,000)
predictors.description: Deaths per 1,000 population among children under age 5.

predictors.label: Thinness, ages 10-19 (%)
predictors.description: % of 10-19 year-olds classified as underweight (thin) for their age.

predictors.label: Alcohol consumption (litres/capita)
predictors.description: Liters of pure alcohol consumed per capita (age 15+ population).

predictors.label: Health expenditure (% of GDP per capita)
predictors.description: Health expenditure as a percentage of GDP per capita.

predictors.label: Total govt. health expenditure (% of total govt. expenditure)
predictors.description: Total government health spending as a percentage of total government spending.

predictors.label: Income Composition of Resources (0-1 index)
predictors.description: A UN Human Development Index sub-component (0-1 scale) capturing how effectively a country converts income into human development outcomes. Higher = more effective.

predictors.label: Schooling (avg. years)
predictors.description: Average number of years of schooling completed.

predictors.label: Measles cases (reported per 1,000)
predictors.description: Number of reported measles cases per 1,000 population.

clipping: learned from training rows only (FoldWinsorizer); target not clipped
